title: Personal Training Packages: the club-membership gate on purchasing Elite Specialty Coaching
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the club-membership basis on which the Elite Specialty Coaching tier may be purchased.

## Rule
Elite Specialty Coaching may be purchased only by a member whose club membership status is active and whose club membership tier ladder rank is at least the tier's own minimum membership tier rank requirement. A member whose membership is lower-ranked or inactive must upgrade their club membership first before purchasing this tier.

## Points of judgement
- If the member's club membership status is active and their membership tier ladder rank is at least the required minimum, the member may purchase Elite Specialty Coaching.
- If the member's club membership status is not active, the member may not purchase Elite Specialty Coaching regardless of their membership tier ladder rank.
- If the member's club membership status is active but their membership tier ladder rank is below the required minimum, the member may not purchase Elite Specialty Coaching until their membership is upgraded to a qualifying rank.
The membership record on file for the purchasing member is the authority for both the status check and the rank check; a membership held by a different person does not satisfy this gate.
